summary: The gyomu-infra package provides comprehensive core infrastructure and utility components for the Gyomu system. It delivers robust data processing capabilities including CSV parsing with Pydantic integration, filesystem and stream operations, database persistence via SQLAlchemy repositories and transaction management, and specialized domain services like business calendars and parameter resolution.
responsibilities: Provide infrastructure and utility services supporting data parsing, storage, and domain logic.
Manage persistent data access via SQLAlchemy repositories, connections, and transactions.
Implement core domain-specific services including business calendars, parameters, and variable translation.
Offer robust file system, stream processing, and archive management tools.

capabilities.name: CSV Data Processing
capabilities.description: Read, parse, serialize, and configure CSV data handling integrated with Pydantic data models.

capabilities.name: Filesystem Utilities
capabilities.description: Provide robust filesystem utilities for file I/O, searching, enumeration, and access management.

capabilities.name: Database Management
capabilities.description: Manage database connections, SQLAlchemy repository patterns, transactions, and error handling.

capabilities.name: Gyomu Domain Services
capabilities.description: Perform business calendar calculations, holiday services, parameter access, and variable translation.

capabilities.name: Core System Utilities
capabilities.description: Support general-purpose utilities including lazy stream processing, process execution, hashing, and archiving.

design_decisions: Leverages Pydantic for data validation and schema mapping across CSV parsing and database entities.
Implements standard repository patterns and transaction managers using SQLAlchemy for database interactions.
Provides functional error handling and lazy evaluation paradigms using libraries like returns.
usage_guidance: Use the CSV modules for reading and writing validated Pydantic records from and to CSV files or strings.
Leverage the filesystem and stream utilities for safe file handling, text/JSON I/O, and lazy stream processing.
Utilize SQLAlchemy-based repositories and transaction managers for interacting with underlying databases.
Incorporate business calendar and parameter access services for date-driven domain logic and variable resolution.
